csharpDecision: EmitBoxExpression uses CopiesFixedStorageField and CopyFixedStorageValue before allocating/storing the box. Names and fixed storage field projections receive independent recursively copied backing; temporaries transfer.
nativeDecision: Reuse aggregateFieldCopiesFixedStorage for Box destination element identity and emitCopyableFixedStorageValue for recursive copy. Preserve loaded readonly values and existing aggregate consumers; no second copier.
